items.title: SpaceX Short Interest Falls to 11% From 34% Peak: Are Bears Capitulating?
items.summary: SpaceX short interest cratered from a 34% peak to 11% as shares rebound 41% off their August low, S3 Partners data shows.

items.title: The Latest Robotics IPO is 8000X Oversubscribed. These ETFs Could Take Off if Humanoid Robotics Are The Next Big Thing.
items.summary: A Chinese humanoid robotics IPO just shattered demand records, and the shockwave is already hitting a handful of niche ETFs built exactly for this moment. Whether that momentum holds depends on two wildcards most investors are not watching closely enough.

items.title: Tesla Cars Facing More Demand Than Stock? Buyers Face Extended Waits For Base Model 3, Model Y And Cybertruck
items.summary: According to Tesla’s online configurator, new custom orders for the base Model 3 Rear-Wheel Drive now show estimated delivery in the first quarter of 2027, while the Cybertruck base variant shows a wait time until sometime next year.

items.title: Tesla files plans for proposed $10.1B Texas solar manufacturing plant
items.summary: Tesla, led by Elon Musk, is looking to build a massive solar panel factory just outside Houston, Texas, according to documents filed with the state.

items.title: Trump’s Capital Gains Tax Cut Plan Could Save Elon Musk Millions — Maybe Billions — of Dollars on Tesla
items.summary: A Washington tax proposal targeting inflation adjustments on capital gains could reshape what Elon Musk eventually owes on his massive Tesla stake, but the math reveals a far messier picture than the headlines suggest.

items.summary: A National Football League coach driving his Tesla Inc vehicle was recently involved in a car crash. Instead of blaming Tesla and the car’s self-driving features, the coach is taking responsibility and shares an important lesson as autonomous vehicles advance....

items.title: Elon Musk: SpaceX’s AI Revenue Will Surpass Its Entire Space Business “Next Month”
items.summary: Elon Musk just told SpaceX employees that a business most people have never heard of will soon dwarf rockets, Starlink, and every other revenue line the company has ever built, and he gave a specific month.
